lines.text: One price drove most of inflation's jump to 3.7%.

lines.text: The biggest driver is gas. The gasoline index jumped 9.1% in September.

post.title: One price drove most of inflation's jump to 3.7%
post.ig:
One price drove most of inflation's jump to 3.7%.
US consumer prices rose 3.7% in the year through September 2026, up from 3.4% in August (forecast: 3.6%).
The gasoline index jumped 9.1% in September alone, over half the monthly rise, and is up 34% over 12 months. Groceries are up 1.8%.
Core inflation (ex food and energy) rose to 2.6% from 2.4%. The Fed's next decision is October 28.
Sources: BLS CPI release (Oct 14, 2026), CNBC, CNN, Fox Business.
News and education, not financial advice.
